Name: Dokuta Yogano
Sex: Male
Age: 42 [spoiler](in [i]AI[/i]) | 48 (in [i]AINI[/i] Present)[/spoiler]
Birthday: March 14

Likes: Dominatrixes [spoiler](AI); Iomante, The Sound of Civilization, Old Man Shamo (AINI)[/spoiler]

Hobbies: Dissection [spoiler](AI); Old Man Shamo Festival (AINI)[/spoiler]

In [i][url=/v26532]AI: The Somnium Files[/url][/i]:
Dokuta Yogano is a member of the Kumakura Family, having first worked under Rohan Kumakura, and later Moma Kumakura. Perhaps due to the way he looks, he is often mistaken for a low-ranking member even though he is toward the top. He typically does office work. He has recently fallen in love and lost a lot of weight.

[spoiler]In [i][url=/v31469]AI: The Somnium Files - nirvanA Initiative[/url][/I] (Present):
Kumakura member. He isn't taking the divorce well... He says weird things, but that's supposedly caused by watching the Nirvana Trial video.[/spoiler]

[Edited from the in-game character descriptions]

[spoiler]Dokuta works as the resident mob doctor for the Kumakuras; his name is a pun on 闇のドクター (underground doctor). He's acquainted with Renju Okiura and Hitomi Sagan, even helping give birth to Iris Sagan and patching an injured Falco in the past. In the first game, he gained a fiancee, the nurse Hanayo Nasu from Central Hospital. In the second game (Present), he and Nasu are divorced.[/spoiler]
